Class Budget

java.lang.Object
com.duck.model.records.Budget
public class Budget extends Object
Represents a budget for a specific category within a date period. Tracks the total limit, the amount already spent, an alert threshold percentage, and the owning Account. A budget is considered active when the current date falls within its period.
